title: Pointwise left Kan extensions have the mapping-space universal property
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent diagrams, transformations, functor categories, mapping spaces, and colimiting cocones as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in fixed sufficiently large universes. Let $C,D$ be quasicategories, $K$ a small simplicial set, $\delta:K\to C$ and $F_0:K\to D$ diagrams, $F:C\to D$ a functor, and $\beta:F_0\to F\delta$ a coherent transformation. For $c\in C$, let $C_{/c}$ be the simplicial set whose $n$-simplices are maps $\Delta^n\star\Delta^0\to C$ taking the last vertex to $c$, with projection to $C$ by the first face; the join concatenates the vertices of its two factors in that order. Put $K_{/c}=K\times_C C_{/c}$. Suppose that for every $c$ the coherent cocone on $K_{/c}$ induced by $\beta$ and the universal arrows $\delta k\to c$, whose legs are
$$F_0(k)\xrightarrow{\beta_k}F(\delta k)\xrightarrow{F(u)}F(c),\qquad u:\delta k\to c,$$
is colimiting. Then for every functor $G:C\to D$, restriction followed by composition with $\beta$ induces an equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(C,D)}(F,G)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(K,D)}(F_0,G\delta),\qquad \alpha\longmapsto(\alpha\delta)\beta.$$
This concerns the full coherent transformation spaces and is natural in $G$. No other colimits in $D$ are assumed to exist.

source.place: Kerodon Proposition 7.3.6.1 (0309), with pointwise left Kan extensions defined in Variant 7.3.1.5 (02YC). The comma indexing simplicial set and its cocone are written out here rather than left as a notion defined only by tag. These are Kerodon tags, not Stacks tags; read online, not archived in literature/.
